# Vendored ffmpeg-skill

Upstream repository [kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill](https://github.com/kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill).

- **Commit** [`0ddd64a667eabbbcd12ef7a02d3b5e924fcae96c`](https://github.com/kajisho5/ffmpeg-skill/commit/0ddd64a667eabbbcd12ef7a02d3b5e924fcae96c)
- **Package version** 3.11.3
- **License** [MIT](LICENSE)
- **Snapshot** `bin/`, `scripts/`, `references/`, `templates/`, `mcp/`, `docs/contract.md` and the root license, README, security policy, skill and package manifest. These paths are copied unchanged from the commit. The upstream repository hosts its demos, website and upstream test suite.

The Crispy integration calls `check.py` and `look.py` for a completed local render. Optional system filters, encoders and speech engines required by other tools are provided separately. See [local video editing](../../../docs/video-editor.md).
